notes.title: Patch v3.0 is out now!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/e34962edb46160eef9deda40e6f038b868b0cac2.png"][/img][/p][h2]New patch resolving game issues! Version 3.0 is now available for download![/h2][p][/p][p][b]Hello everyone! This is the AniCore Team. A lot of time has passed since the game’s release, and during this time, we’ve been receiving bug reports from you regarding various issues. We sincerely apologize for taking so long to address these problems. Significant changes have occurred in the studio since the release, affecting both the development of new games and the fixing of older ones. Stress, burnout, and so on. Unfortunately, we’re only human, and it caught up with us. HOWEVER! We’ve gathered our strength and finally fixed the game![/b][/p][p][b]Now, let’s move on to the changes! There aren’t too many, but they will allow you to comfortably complete the game.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]The DMS bug (where you either couldn’t receive it or the game would freeze after reading the message, preventing you from continuing the story) has been fixed. We resolved this issue quite simply — now DMS messages are received and read automatically (you don’t even need to open the phone).[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Work has been done to optimize the game and slightly improve the visuals, though not too noticeably.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor bugs with mini-games have been fixed.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]We continue working on our projects and hope for your positive feedback on our efforts. In turn, we will do our best to delight you with new games and hot content![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Best regards,  [/b][/p][p][b]AniCore Team![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]ADD TO YOUR WISHLISTS OUR FUTURE GAMES:[/u][/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576330/Hentai_Tavern/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576110/Memories_with_You/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Happy Valentine's Day 💘 We have released a new update 2.1.0 🎁
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/8187cd021bda542558db9bc0422fae6923947d4c.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Hey there! Happy Valentine's Day to everyone! 💘💘💘[/b][/u] We hope you've already met your soulmate in [b]Summer For You[/b], and we wish everyone finds their favorite waifu in real life too. Hentai is hentai, but there is nothing better than real hot sex between two in-love 𓆩❤️‍🔥𓆪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/0e676a5ae9f4c529fd93b7c9aae9cdf3a643e588.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Meanwhile, we've made a new update to celebrate this holiday! And it includes new additional content 🎁[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Our hero lover chooses with whom he wants to spend February 14 this time
[*] Updated mini game with cakes, there is now a new menu for February 14
[*] Updated mini game with cleaning, you need to clean the lobby for the date
[*] Updated mini game with item arrangement, new recipes + collecting flowers
[*] New stories are added
[*] And of course you can expect 4 new hot new arts with each of the heroines, so why not 5? And here is a surprise - with which our hero decided to have fun in threesome.[/list] [h3][b]📣 IMPORTANT NOTE[/b][/h3]
You need to go to any of the good endings (Misha/Naomi/Samantha) to get the event for February 14 up and the new quests will start automatically in the game after you open the ending!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/7f9b1e1a1cac2fcc82d3e1c79549da1a66aa9ad0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/46da21b1e11f35de36b308b53e841338f87acda1.jpg[/img]

[i][b]We are happy if you enjoy our new content as well as have a good time tonight[/b][/i] 😎

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50023

[b][h3]ALSO WE WOULD LIKE TO TELL YOU THAT TODAY WE FINALLY RELEASED A GAME FROM OUR FRIENDS PUBLISHERS - HENTAI STORIES! 5 DIFFERENT STORIES AND 27 ANIMATED AND VOICED H-SCENES WAITING FOR YOU 🔥[/h3][/b]

notes.title: New version of the game! We have made Steam Trading Cards, and other good news!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/a528aad2b86f76e169070514e29bd3e78af38dd7.jpg[/img]

[b]Our beloved players, we finally have some good news for you! 🥰
[/b]

First of all. [b]We have reconfigured the game[/b], and all future updates will begin from 2, such as v2.0.1 and so forth. We have fixed everything we could, but it’s not impossible you’ll find something - don’t be afraid to write a report in our Discord - we will try to fix it and help you as fast as possible!

[i]Please, ensure that you have the latest version and there are no pending updates on Steam before playing.[/i]

[b]Fixes: [/b]

- Fixed the plot structure, making it more linear
- Fixed bugs related to puzzles
- Fixed minor graphical bugs
- Fixed many major bugs

[b]We also have to remind you that the sale is going on until February 13th! Buy yourself a girt before Valentine’s Day! 😈[/b]

Don't forget about the Hentai Bundle 💝

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50023/HENTAI/

[b][i]You can continue your playthrough using your old save, but we recommend starting a new playthrough so that you can enjoy the game in full![/i][/b]

Second of all. [b]WE GOT APPROVED FOR STEAM TRADING CARDS! [/b]We hope someone already got some of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/be23eab83ce3b1f714255d0539c3c632b9dc04df.jpg[/img]

We won’t make a poll just yet, please share your opinion in the comments!

And don’t forget to wishlist our puiblisher’s games!

[h3][b]Thank you so much for your support, feedback and patience! We see what you play, discuss, share your impressions - and it's priceless for us ❤️‍🩹[/b][/h3]

[i]Unfortunately, yes, bugs have happened and we are ashamed of them 😢[/i]

notes.title: We are forced to postpone the release to January 31st 😭 (not our fault)
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, we have to postpone the release of our game Summer For You to January 31st.[/b] The reason: our game is still on moderation process. Now our game is completely ready and we are only waiting for approval from Steam administration to allow us so that we can release the game 👈

With this decision comes a great sadness for us 😭😭😭 Unfortunately, we were not able to influence in any way to speed up the checkout of our game, although we wrote several times to Steam Support about it. We love everyone and promise that our game will get even better over the next week, which we will spend to create some more exclusives!

[h3][b]We hope you don't reject us and understand this situation 🙏🥺[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980/Summer_For_You

notes.title: 3 Days Until Release 🚩 Facts about the development of our game 🚀
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/8cc0fde7e08a5bb92a7b03147ba53c1512b61b0d.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]T H R E E DAYS UNTIL RELEASE!!! ON JANUARY 24TH THE RELEASE WILL FINALLY HAPPEN 🚀🚀🚀[/b][/h3]

We have finished almost all major tasks connected with the development of our game, and now we are just working on improving achievements, some visual layout and small things. We remind you that the release will take place at [b]11PM Hongkong time, 3PM London time and 12PM New York time[/b] ⏰

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980/Summer_For_You

[h3][b]But for now, we will give you some facts about development of our game:[/b][/h3]
1️⃣ The game has been in development since July 2024.

2️⃣ The story of the game is a reference to the old game - Forever To You, but it is not a continuation of this game. Just let them be parallel universes, because it's so trendy nowadays...

3️⃣ The plot was rewritten during development. Things happen…

4️⃣ There are only 4 people participating in the development of the game.

5️⃣ The game has 5 main female characters that you can 🍆🍑😩👉👌💦 with.

6️⃣ We've changed minigames in the demo versions a few times based on players' feedback.

7️⃣ We like the number 7, perhaps that's the release date. 2 + 4 + 01 = 7 💡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/81c1672934527d6cb1d61c1632da1f67fc9f8b21.png[/img]

[b]Also, don't forget to add Hentai Stories game from our publishers Horny Capybara to your wishlist! The game comes out in a week, on January 30 🔥[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642820/Hentai_Stories/
